feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 October 2026 4:34pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 25 October 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales at first. Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Very deep low (Storm Boelo) in the North Sea, tracking eastwards.


##Wind##

West 7 or gale 8, decreasing 6 or 7 early tonight, backing south or southwest 4 or 5 later in the night. Then backing south or southeast 6 or 7 tomorrow morning, veering south or southwest in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, occasionally very rough in the east at first, becoming mainly moderate overnight, then building moderate or rough tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, rain for a time tomorrow morning. Becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain for a time.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 6 or 7, increasing 7 or gale 8, possibly severe gale 9 in places for a time, veering west or southwest 6 or 7 later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming rough or very rough for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then rain for a time, showers later.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, becoming moderate or poor in rain.
